question: For exactly matched nORF products, is cross-screen fitness agreement retained with guides absent from the older library, and do reused and fresh guides produce different abundance changes within the newer assay?
known_before_new_analysis: Complete source phenotype tables and overall benchmarks were inspected in prior cycles; this is retrospective reanalysis.
C86identity/reagentinventory is independentlyverified:127exactcompletecodingchainpairs;all127reuseatleastoneguide. No guide-reuse-conditioned outcomes have been inspected.
Three literal commoncelllabels are A375,A549,HEPG2; no cell-label alias rescue is needed.
primary_product_cohort: All127 C86 exact_complete_reference_coding_chain_and_DNA pairs; two unmapped oldercandidates and all other relations remain in complete inventories, not imputed as negatives.
primary_guide_eligibility: Existing C83 primary_geometry_eligible: unique primary-chromosome NGG site with expected cut inside assigned ORF, single source target assignment, and full protospacer avoiding current CDS on either strand. Newer guides additionally require all3sourceplasmid counts>=10. Older guide LFCs must be source-present; missing is retained, never negative.

guide_groups.reused: Exact20ntsequence present among the matched older ORF assigned guides; guide need not pass older current-annotation eligibility to count as a reused reagent, but the old target score uses eligible old guides.
guide_groups.fresh: Exact20ntsequence absent from the entire original5776-guide source library, including controls and other targets.
guide_groups.other_old_library_reuse: Present in older library but assigned to another target; retained as separateexcludedgroup, not called fresh.

paired_eligibility: At least1 eligible older guide and at least1 eligible newer reused and1 newer fresh guide for the product; all3sharedcells must have source measurements. No expression threshold in primary cohort. Missing/gate failures retained in all127denominators.

measurements.older: Median released LFC_D21_relative_to_pDNA across eligible old guides for each product/cell; no original Chronos score or hit flag substituted.
measurements.newer: Existing independentlyverified C83 LFC: meanlog2(3lateprovidedcounts+1)-meanlog2(3plasmidprovidedcounts+1). Source-provided abundance endpoint, not infectedearly/CNV-corrected score.
measurements.new_group_aggregation: Arithmetic mean of eligible per-guide LFCs within each product/cell/group.

primary_endpoints.within_newer_depletion_difference: Newer fresh-group mean LFC minus reused-group mean LFC; equalmean over3sharedcells withinproduct, then equalproductmean. Positive means reusedguides showmoredepletion.
primary_endpoints.cross_screen_rank_agreement_difference: Within each sharedcell, Spearman rho(oldermedian,newerreusedmean)-rho(oldermedian,newerfreshmean), using exactly the same eligible products. Equalmean of the3cell-specific differences. Individual correlations and source sample sizes retained.

uncertainty.dependence_clusters: Union connected components of matched product pairs sharing C66 oldsource exoniclocus clusters or C70 newer sourcegene/exonic dependence_union_cluster; wholeproduct allcell/guide rows travel together.
uncertainty.primary_family: Two primary endpoints; 97.5% percentile cluster-bootstrap intervals for each. No universal population or clinical interpretation.
uncertainty.inferential_gate: At least10independent clusters and10products, with nonconstant finite scores for every requiredcell correlation; otherwise descriptive/noCI. Do not relax gate.
uncertainty.bootstrap_missing_rule: Retain and report any undefined bootstrap statistic; do not quietly discard. If undefined draws exceed1%, no inferential interval for that endpoint.

frozen_sensitivities: Source older mean instead of median, with allotherprimary eligibilityfixed.
No current CDS exclusion: unique primaryNGGinsideassignedORF only; retaincurrentCDSflags and primarypDNAcoverage.
Exclude prior source DNA-AA-other-disagreement candidates; no sequence repair.
Expression-qualified cohort: source2026 RNA>=10TPM and Ribo>=5TPM in all3sharedcells; unknownexcludedasunknown.
At least2eligible newer guides in each reused/fresh group.
Newer pseudocount0.5and5 from originalsourceBcounts; retain primaryguide eligibility and originalpDNAcoverage.
Three leave-one-common-cell-out point estimates; no bestcellselection.

Guide-count-balanced comparison:1000seeded draws perprimarycohort, selectk=min(nreused,nfresh)guideswithoutreplacementfromeachgroup perproduct, same selectedguides across3cells. Saveeverydraw, individualcorrelations and differences; variation overguidechoices is a descriptiveguide-subset distribution, not biologicalCI.
additional_uncertainty_scope: Bootstrap primary only; secondary sensitivities are descriptive complete point-estimate inventories, not additional discoveries or independent validations.
claim_limits: Guide-reuse association may reflect on-target efficiency, prior reagent selection, guidecount-dependent precision or off-target effects; it does not identify any one mechanism.
Fresh-guide agreement is not proof of peptide causality; DNA cuts can affect RNA, regulation or copy-number-related toxicity.
Assays use different dates/batches and processednormalization; rankcomparisons and within-newer contrasts do not establish common absolute scales.
Originalnewerexperiment is independent as an assay evenwhenreagentsare reused. Reuse does not make all replication invalid.
Gene/locus relations in C86 are not asserted to be authors claims of full-productreplication.
No clinical efficacy, safety, newtranslation or absolutepriority claim.
